description: While correcting the guides for the Demux-streaming work (bedrock-qzr.6), a pass over all ~40 guide files surfaced pre-existing drift unrelated to that branch: broken links to never-written pages, dead code paths from the storage->materializer rename, sections describing mechanisms that do not exist in the implementation, malformed glossary formatting, and stale status documents. Each child ticket is a verified observation, not a suspicion — file paths and line numbers checked against the tree at worktree-qzr2-wal-trim (6484e63a).
title: Guides accuracy audit: pre-existing drift between docs and code
